<h2>Reshape Community Data to Long Format</h2>

<h3>Description</h3>

<p>Reshapes wide community counts to one taxon observation per row.
</p>


<h3>Usage</h3>

<pre><code class='language-R'>reshape_community_to_long(data_community = NULL)
</code></pre>


<h3>Arguments</h3>

<table role = "presentation">
<tr><td><code id="data_community">data_community</code></td>
<td>
<p>A wide data frame containing 'dataset_name', 'sample_name', and at least one
taxon-count column.</p>
</td></tr>
</table>


<h3>Details</h3>

<p>Missing taxon counts are omitted from the returned long data.
</p>


<h3>Value</h3>

<p>A data frame in long format with columns 'dataset_name', 'sample_name',
'taxon', and 'pollen_count'.
</p>


<h3>Examples</h3>

<pre><code class='language-R'>data_community &lt;-
  tibble::tibble(
    dataset_name = "example",
    sample_name = "sample_1",
    Pinus = 10,
    Betula = 5
  )

reshape_community_to_long(data_community = data_community)
</code></pre>

</main>
